title: Emergency Heating
description: What never to use for heat indoors, and how to use fireplaces, space heaters, and unvented fuel heaters more safely with CO alarms. Covers warming one room, dressing and sleeping warm, recognizing hypothermia, and when to leave for a warming center.
shortDescription: Staying warm in an outage without CO poisoning or fires, and what never to use
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
